assumptions: CP5b seven cuts are hypothetical nonstarters, not real historical decisions.

Uniform 5, 15, 30, 50 percent retained Salary on ANY candidate cut is a sensitivity bound and is NOT individually verified real tenure. Exact cutoff rates would require full 2024-26 team acquisition/ownership history, active Salary portability and floor.

For exhaustive cut-only feasibility each September starter (13 of 13 per team) is frozen as protected; every other held player is eligible for removal. This is an arithmetic lower bound, not an agreement of managers to waive future trade/dynasty options.

All cuts are considered one cycle and individual retained amount is rounded half up per cut. No subsequent player re-acquisition or floor imposed, so its portable active Salary is not used in this isolated seller-side settlement.
No previous June debt in standalone F2-new-retention tests. Independent carry-in exposure test keeps CP5d June 2026 debt as separate preexisting loan and NEVER originates it again at F2.
An additional F2 cap checkpoint does not reset annual Salaries or Dead Cap, does not become a new vintage payment deadline, and is NOT equivalent to annual reprice.

After-seven-cut single trade tests change exactly one of the seven cut candidates into an unretained full-Salary trade to one buyer; only actual freed regular slots count, and all other six cut decisions stay fixed. Pairs are independent and NOT a jointly feasible trade set.

The naive frozen 2026 future H2/H3 annual payment is not a 2027 forecast. For a true C-add+F2+Debt multiyear result the loan/vintage origin, old-vs-new debt at F2, active Salary reductions after June cut, manager actions and 2027 prices are unavailable.
All six teams had zero open regular spots before hypothetical post-FA cuts. Salary/roster calculations do not invent Taxi/Reserve movements.
Commissioner time, accepted buyer/seller offers, title probabilities and real hard deadline sanctions are unobserved.
